children.game_version: Play a game where children dance slowly like gentle ocean waves and speed up their knee bounces when the drum beats faster, freezing in place on command.

seniors.counts: Perform movements in steady 4-count cycles rather than accelerating.
seniors.seated_version: Perform hip oscillations and upper-body expressive gestures while seated firmly on a sturdy armless chair with feet flat on the floor.
seniors.standing_version: Stand with one hand lightly resting on a ballet barre or chair back, practicing gentle knee flexion and soft pelvic rotations.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a steady, slow-to-moderate tempo; limit pelvic range of motion to pain-free arcs.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Gestures conveying pantomime and dramatic narrative, supporting the rhythmic movement of the body.
movement_profile.footwork: Barefoot weight shifts maintaining grounded connection to the earth while supporting rapid knee and thigh movements.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Coupled pairs of boys and girls interacting in close proximity within an open communal space or garden.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Rapid, whirling movements of the thighs, knees, and loins/reins, accompanied by continuous shaking of the torso and whole body.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Primarily grounded level; jumps not described in sources.
movement_profile.partnering: Couples dancing opposite one another with expressive, sexually oriented interactions culminating at times in an embrace.
movement_profile.posture: Grounded, upright posture danced barefoot with softened knees to facilitate rapid lower-body oscillation.

signature_moves.description: Rapid circular and vibrating movements of the pelvis, thighs, and knees.
signature_moves.name: Whirling of the reins

signature_moves.description: Culminating dramatic hold between paired male and female dancers.
signature_moves.name: Partner embrace

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Gradual accelerando from a measured, deliberate pulse to an ecstatic, driving finish.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stiff knees or isolated upper-body tension that disrupts the natural rotational mechanics of the pelvis.

music_profile.musical_form: Continuous progressive acceleration from a slow, measured introduction to an intense, sustained climax.
music_profile.sound_description: A repetitive, hypnotic acoustic texture driven by wooden or skin drums and melodic flute lines, overlaid with rhythmic leader-led chanting that shifts from restrained phrasing into urgent, percussive vocalizations.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chanted verse led by a soloist or leader, escalating from measured delivery to heightened vocalizations and inarticulate cries.

basic_steps: Stand barefoot with knees softly bent and weight grounded.
Isolate the pelvis and thighs to initiate a rapid, whirling rotation of the knees, thighs, and lower back.
Coordinate full-body shaking while maintaining grounded contact through the feet.
Pair with a partner facing closely, syncing hip and thigh rotations in time with drum cadences.
teaching.formation: Couples arranged in boy-and-girl pairs, guided by a lead caller or game master.
teaching.level_notes: Requires intense stamina, knee stability, and pelvic articulation to sustain rapid continuous rotation.
teaching.rhythm: Begins at a slow, measured tempo and progressively accelerates to a rapid, high-intensity cadence.
